purpose: Frozen reproduction inputs for the fact-quality gates. Rows copied verbatim from pinned commits are bank rows, not Firestore source documents. Expected values in frozen_cases are fixed by the plan; do not regenerate them from live sources.

role_legend.confirmed_wrong_value: stored claim contradicted by cited evidence (debut vs return)
role_legend.impossible_candidate_range: answer supported; independent context bounds reject stored/routable candidates
role_legend.entity_numeral_collision: candidate equals a numeral inside the entity name; statement gate must filter
role_legend.consequential_source_conflict: same-publisher numerical disagreement on the same metric; hold for review
role_legend.supported_rounded_value: valid control: explicitly rounded source-supported value must qualify
role_legend.display_precision_loss: supported value misrendered by kind-level display policy
role_legend.valid_control: supported value that must continue to qualify
role_legend.removed_conflicting_answer: removed by producing run; retained for review regression, not evidence removal was wrong
role_legend.synthetic_same_identity_correction: synthetic: same subject/angle/fact_id with corrected value
role_legend.synthetic_distinct_return_identity: synthetic: different angle; must never reuse the debut identity
